newsitem.title: USA: McCormick & Co relaunches dry seasoning.
newsitem.headline: McCormick & Co relaunches dry seasoning.

text.p: McCormick & Co Inc said Thursday it is relaunching its dry seasoning mix product line with packaging changes that include updated food graphics, and easier-to-read instructions for preparation.
The company also said the new packaging includes stronger brand identification and a menu shopping list.
The company said it will also have new point-of-sale materials and store signs.
The company did not disclose information on how much money it will invest in this product.
McCormick makes spices, seasonings, flavorings, and specialty foods.
